record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> concerning all the Jews<WH03064> which dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, which dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> at Migdol<WH04024>, and at Tahpanhes<WH08471>, and at Noph<WH05297>, and in the country<WH0776> of Pathros<WH06624>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Howbeit I sent<WH07971><WTH8799> unto you all my servants<WH05650> the prophets<WH05030>, rising early<WH07925><WTH8687> and sending<WH07971><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> , saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Oh, do<WH06213><WTH8799> not this abominable<WH08441> thing<WH01697> that I hate<WH08130><WTH8804>.

But they hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> not, nor inclined<WH05186><WTH8689> their ear<WH0241> to turn<WH07725><WTH8800> from their wickedness<WH07451>, to burn no incense<WH06999><WTH8763> unto other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>.

Therefore now thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of hosts<WH06635>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; Wherefore commit<WH06213><WTH8802> ye <FI>this<Fi> great<WH01419> evil<WH07451> against your souls<WH05315>, to cut off<WH03772><WTH8687> from you man<WH0376> and woman<WH0802>, child<WH05768> and suckling<WH03243><WTH8802>, out<WH08432> of Judah<WH03063>, to leave<WH03498><WTH8687> you none to remain<WH07611>; <RF>out...: Heb. out of the midst of Judah<Rf>

In that ye provoke me unto wrath<WH03707><WTH8687> with the works<WH04639> of your hands<WH03027>, burning incense<WH06999><WTH8763> unto other<WH0312> gods<WH0430> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>, whither ye be gone<WH0935><WTH8802> to dwell<WH01481><WTH8800>, that ye might cut yourselves off<WH03772><WTH8687>, and that ye might be a curse<WH07045> and a reproach<WH02781> among all the nations<WH01471> of the earth<WH0776>?

Have ye forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> the wickedness<WH07451> of your fathers<WH01>, and the wickedness<WH07451> of the kings<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and the wickedness<WH07451> of their wives<WH0802>, and your own wickedness<WH07451>, and the wickedness<WH07451> of your wives<WH0802>, which they have committed<WH06213><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Judah<WH03063>, and in the streets<WH02351> of Jerusalem<WH03389>? <RF>wickedness...: Heb. wickednesses, or, punishments, etc<Rf>

They are not humbled<WH01792><WTH8795> <FI>even<Fi> unto this day<WH03117>, neither have they feared<WH03372><WTH8804>, nor walked<WH01980><WTH8804> in my law<WH08451>, nor in my statutes<WH02708>, that I set<WH05414><WTH8804> before<WH06440> you and before<WH06440> your fathers<WH01>. <RF>humbled: Heb. contrite<Rf>

Then Jeremiah<WH03414> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto all the people<WH05971>, to the men<WH01397>, and to the women<WH0802>, and to all the people<WH05971> which had given him <FI>that<Fi> answer<WH01697><WH06030><WTH8802>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
